contract.task: Estimate the house price per unit area in Sindian, New Taipei City, Taiwan.
contract.context: house_age_years: age in years; mrt_distance_m: distance to the nearest MRT station in metres; convenience_stores: nearby store count; latitude and longitude: degrees. transaction_date retains the source decimal-year code. One ping is approximately 3.3 square metres. The target is not the total property price.
contract.group_note: Recorded property descriptors, excluding transaction date; not a verified property ID.

grouping_rule: Recorded property descriptors, excluding transaction date; not a verified property ID. Identical prepared inputs are additionally unioned to prevent duplicate-input leakage.
deduplication_policy: One example per identical task/input/label; source_refs and duplicate_count preserve multiplicity. Different labels retained.
missing_policy: null; no statistical imputation; two nonpositive Abalone heights and ten nonpositive Metro Kelvin temperatures are converted to null in their respective sources.
split_policy: UNASSIGNED: choose dataset-family holdouts and appropriate grouped/chronological splits before training. group_id prevents known overlap but does not prove independence.

license.name: CC BY 4.0, as stated by the UCI dataset page

citation_paper.title: Building real estate valuation models with comparative approach through case-based reasoning

quality_findings.detail: Different targets for the same input can represent noise or unobserved variables; they are not averaged or deleted.
Identical task/input/label examples are stored once with duplicate_count. This is a deduplication policy, not proof that all originals are erroneous.

source_values_policy: No learned feature scaling, target normalization, truncation, oversampling or label clipping; unknown physical units explicitly identified.

numeric_precision.rule: Non-integral finite floats rounded to at most 12 significant decimal digits; integers, null and strings unchanged; no fixed decimal-place rounding or clipping.

prepared_profile_scope: Original prepared table before task deduplication/label exclusions, retained from v2.0.0.
distribution_format: UTF-8 JSON Lines, gzip compressed, at most 100000 records per shard
